client.name: Listo HVAC Solutions LLC dba Eco Air Conditioning

policies.name: General Liability
policies.description: Protects against claims of bodily injury or property damage to others.
policies.fullDescription: This General Liability policy provides coverage for bodily injury, property damage, personal and advertising injury, and medical expenses. It includes specific limits for General Aggregate, Products-Completed Operations Aggregate, Personal and Advertising Injury, Damage to Premises Rented to You, Each Occurrence, and Medical Expense. Terrorism coverage is included at $0.00 premium where legally required, with options to add broader coverage.
keyFeatures: Includes coverage for Personal and Advertising Injury.
Automatic status for Additional Insured - Completed Operations when required by contract.
Automatic Waiver of Transfer of Rights of Recovery when required by contract.
Coverage for Damage to Premises Rented to You up to $100,000.
Optional coverages for Bail Bonds, Extended Nonowned Watercraft, and Newly Acquired Organizations.

covered: A customer slips and falls on your business premises, sustaining an injury.
Property damage caused by your operations at a client's site.
Legal defense costs for a claim of libel or slander.
Medical payments for a minor injury sustained by a visitor on your property.
notCovered: Damage to your own business property (covered by property insurance).
Professional errors or omissions in HVAC servicing design (covered by E&O insurance).
Injuries to your employees (covered by Workers' Compensation).
Claims arising from nuclear energy, asbestos, or fungi/bacteria.

policies.name: Commercial Excess Liability
policies.description: Provides additional liability coverage above primary policies.
policies.fullDescription: This policy provides additional liability coverage, including General Aggregate, Products-Completed Aggregate, and Each Occurrence limits, above the underlying General Liability policy. Terrorism coverage can be included for an additional premium.
keyFeatures: Provides coverage above underlying General Liability limits.
Underlying liability judgment factor of 1.00 for Premises/Operations and Products/Completed Operations.

covered: Legal defense costs and damages if a large claim exceeds primary General Liability limits.
Additional protection for claims arising from completed projects or products.
notCovered: Losses specifically excluded by underlying policies or excess policy endorsements (e.g., Nuclear Energy, Asbestos).
Claims arising from acts of terrorism if coverage is not elected.

policies.name: Inland Marine
policies.description: Covers contractors' equipment, tools, and property in transit or at job sites.
policies.fullDescription: This Inland Marine policy specifically covers Contractors' Equipment, including unscheduled equipment with a limit of $50,000 and a maximum item limit of $2,500. It provides coverage for perils to equipment, whether in transit or at various job sites. A deductible of $1,000 applies to unscheduled equipment. Terrorism coverage is included at $0.00 premium where legally required, with options to add broader coverage.
keyFeatures: Coverage for unscheduled contractors' equipment up to $50,000.
Maximum item limit of $2,500 for individual pieces of equipment.
All Insured perils coverage for equipment.

covered: A valuable tool is stolen from a job site overnight.
Equipment is damaged while being transported between client locations.
A piece of machinery is damaged by fire at your workshop.
Loss of unscheduled equipment due to a covered peril.
notCovered: Wear and tear or mechanical breakdown of equipment.
Equipment valued over $2,500 if not specifically scheduled.
Losses due to fraud or dishonest acts by employees.

considerations: Terrorism coverage is initially excluded or limited, with options to add it for an additional premium.
The Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA) program is scheduled to terminate in 2027, which may affect future coverage.
Payment options other than full pay incur a per-installment fee ($2.00 for automatic, $7.00 for direct bill).
Policy premiums are estimates and may be subject to change upon final issuance.
Specific exclusions apply, including Nuclear Energy, Asbestos, Fungi/Bacteria, PFAS, Cannabis, and Unmanned Aircraft.
A $1,000 deductible applies to unscheduled Contractors' Equipment.
coverageStrengths: A+ rated by A.M. Best and Standard & Poor's, recognized as a top 50 best-run carrier.
Best-in-class claims handling with 24/7 reporting and 99.8% same-day contact.
Award-winning service with real people, flexible billing plans, and high customer satisfaction.
Experienced independent agents provide professional service and access to multiple options.
Comprehensive General Liability limits including $2,000,000 General Aggregate and $1,000,000 Each Occurrence.
Contractors' Equipment coverage for tools and property at job sites or in transit.
